system.description:
Spend a Hope to load your weapon
with a Blackwall combat routine until
your next rest.
When you make an attack with this
weapon, use your Interface trait
instead of the trait it normally calls for.
On a success, roll a number of d8s
equal to the current number of Fear the
GM has, up to your level, and deal that
much techno damage as the target's
cyberware, nervous system, or armor
interface is cut open by corrupted
code.
If you succeed with Fear, the target
must also mark a Stress.
